projection.projection_goal: Declare the schema, governance, discovery rules, inheritance policy, and canonicalization contract for the hot-loadable role registry consumed by evaluation-expert-consumer STEP 0 resolveEmployee.

source_slice.slice_topic: authoritative employee role definitions (role_id / industry / responsibility_tags / parent_role inheritance / aliases for canonicalization)

concept_mappings.notes: Registry is populated at PRE.A loadRoleCatalog, before STEP 0 resolveEmployee. Files failing schema validation are SKIPPED with an open_question (fail-soft) — a bad role file never blocks the run. Duplicate role_id keeps the lexicographically-first filename. Only a missing match for the evaluatee's OWN role degrades to a caveat (handled by STEP 0), never a block.

attributes.industry_rule: child overrides parent (child wins when it declares industry; otherwise inherits parent's)
attributes.failure_policy: absent parent / cycle / depth > 8 -> load entry without inheritance + open_question + proceed

attributes.match_semantics: trim + case-insensitive exact match, catalog iteration order, first-match-wins
attributes.on_match: set employee.role.role_id = matched role_id; copy industry + responsibility_tags
attributes.on_miss: keep trimmed free-form string as role_id; append caveat 'role_id_no_catalog_entry'
attributes.single_writer: STEP 0 is the ONLY step permitted to write employee.role.role_id

relation_mappings.notes: Used in PRE.A to compute effective industry + responsibility_tags via parent chain (depth cap 8, fail-soft on cycle/absent/overflow).
Used in STEP 0 to rewrite the evaluatee's free-form role string into a canonical role_id and inject industry + responsibility_tags.

constraint_mappings.notes: The basename of each role file (excluding `.role.json`) MUST equal its `role_id`. Mismatches are skipped at load time with an open_question.
If two files declare the same `role_id`, keep the entry from the lexicographically-first filename, emit an open_question, and proceed. Never block.
Absent parent / cycle / chain depth > 8 -> load the entry without inheritance, emit an open_question, proceed. A bad inheritance edge never blocks the run.
Role canonicalization (free-form string -> role_id) MUST happen ONLY in STEP 0 resolveEmployee. No other step may write employee.role.role_id. Enforced together with workflow-contract K17.

delivery_artifacts.notes: JSON Schema enforced on every loaded *.role.json file.

meta.notes: Role-catalog projection that declares the contract for the hot-loadable role registry. Actual role instances are NOT in this contract — they live as `*.role.json` files in the data layer (`evaluation-expert-consumer/role-catalog/`), one role per file. Consumed by STEP 0 resolveEmployee for canonicalization + industry/responsibility injection.
